findings.title: Illumination can go past 12 with +1 while the page shows 12 / 12
findings.where: Lightkeeper Circle page, any size; backend vtt/ws/handlers/gm.py around line 375 (carry = illumination - TRACK)
findings.steps: Set Illumination to 12 (pip 12), press '+1 Illumination'. Read the database and the page.
findings.expected: Either the +1 stops at 12, or the page shows that 1 is carried over to the next track.
findings.actual: The circle row holds 13; the heading and ring still read '12 / 12' and the -1 button brings it back to 12. The server carries the excess over after the advance, but nothing on the page says so, and FAQ.md has no line on it.

findings.title: Chapter House: a member's unsaved draft hides another member's newer save
findings.where: Circle formation papers (unsealed table), phone 390x844, CircleCreationPopup.jsx handleLocationBlur
findings.steps: Two members open section III. A types ' plus' after the current text and does not leave the box. B saves a different chapter house. Look at A's box.
findings.expected: A is told the shared box changed, or the draft is marked as replacing B's text.
findings.actual: A keeps the old draft with 'Not saved yet'. Leaving the box overwrites B's save with no word. The 'Shared' i says saving replaces what anyone wrote, so it is documented, but nothing tells A at that moment.

findings.title: Advance the circle log does not say the resources refilled
findings.steps: Fill the track to 12 on a table with spent resources and advance the circle.
findings.expected: A log line or the advance line saying resources refill to 1 plus members, since the manual Refill button is gone and the Lightkeeper will look for it.
findings.actual: Only 'The Far Watch has advanced and gained Stamina Training!'. The resources do refill (1/2/0 became 3/3/3).

findings.title: Report line shows only after turning the Lightkeeper's report card
findings.where: Lightkeeper Circle page, report cards, all sizes
findings.steps: A player files a report with a line. Look at the Lightkeeper's card without flipping it.
findings.expected: Per #58 the Lightkeeper reads the line on the report card.
findings.actual: The front shows only the REPORT FILED stamp; the keys and the line are on the back, behind a flip. This matches the card design (nothing says otherwise), but a mark on the front that a line was filed would save a flip.

praise: The Illumination ring reads like a clock face at every size, including 320px, with the milestone pips clear and the candle warming step by step.
The earn-back choice is one press, greyed out for full resources, and survives a reload and a server restart.
Closing the reports with a kept amendment now shows what was sent and keeps the draft for a reopen.
The Well-Read log line now tells the truth: it names only what came back.
method: Folder /home/user/pt4/verify/circle (scripts lib.js, setup.js, setup2.js, ill1-3.js, rep1-5.js, ring1-3.js etc, state_8140.json, screenshots in out_8140 and out_8141). The lib is a copy of v8404_lib.js using P env (8140 main, 8141 control). Table S (Lantern Watch, Resource Management, 3 members, sealed) and N (2 members, no ability) built through the API and sealed in SQL; table F unsealed with 2 members for formation. Reports and Illumination driven through the page and through a Node WebSocket as the Lightkeeper (gm_toggle_reports; SQL changes to reports_open do not broadcast to open desks, so close and reopen reports over the socket). The #55 check rolls survey over a socket and resolves the gilded choice 60 times per build; Slink is forged then patched to Well-Read in SQL (Focus is the label of Read, intuition actions are survey, read, sense). A circle advance opens an advancement dialog on every player desk (set characters.advancement_picks to 0 to move on). Both servers stopped and databases dropped. Not checked: the desk's small summary-card dots (CircleLedger, not on a page I opened), reduced-motion behaviour of the candle, the Lightkeeper's insignia, tablet touch of the pips with a real finger (tapped with the pointer emulation only); one early run saw a first checkbox click on the Lightkeeper's questions not register (twice, could not repeat in a clean run)."]
